name: Gallery Le Déco
about_text: LE DECO (Gallery Le Déco) is a multi-floor rental gallery space in Tokyo that hires out its rooms—spanning basement through several upper floors—to artists, apparel brands, and performers for exhibitions, trunk shows, and live events. Rather than representing artists or curating its own program, it functions as a venue-for-hire, providing floor space for paintings, photography, sculpture, and performance for periods of several days at a time. The gallery does not manage sales, take commission on works sold on-site, or provide invigilation, leaving oversight of artworks and events to the renters themselves.
